name: Voxel Grid Construction from AABB
definition: Constructs a uniform voxel grid from an Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) and a target resolution. It ensures uniform voxel size by scaling based on the longest axis and clamping zero-extent axes.
summary: Voxel Grid Construction from AABB creates a uniform grid from a bounding box and resolution, differing from spherical or rotational methods by enforcing axis-aligned uniformity.
